name: Bound vaults
responsibility: Lists the known vaults whose boards bind one repository, reading each board in memory without writing it
description: TASK-480. The known vaults are the ones the navigator lists: the vault of each chosen checkout and each untracked vault that exist, in the .archboard/vault layout. A board counts when a node of any variant binds the repository. Each file is decoded in memory, so no lease is taken and no migration is written in another repository's vault.

outgoing.label: the chosen checkouts and untracked vaults
